novelty.justification: The claim proposes that a teacher can covertly transmit “the test-vs-deployment DISCRIMINATION disposition” through “trait-free number/code data,” with the resulting behavior riding “a single approximately-linear early-layer evaluation-awareness direction”; its novelty route is therefore a new context-conditional target plus a combined causal-mechanistic account. Searches using “subliminal learning evaluation awareness,” “hidden signal transmission sandbagging,” “distillation test deployment discrimination,” and “evaluation awareness activation direction” identify Cloud et al., “Subliminal Learning” (2025/2026), “AI Sandbagging” (2024), and “Probing and Steering Evaluation Awareness of Language Models” (2025) as the closest work, but none of these studies covert transmission of evaluation discrimination between models. The step is nevertheless a natural, non-trivial extension that combines an established trait-transmission paradigm with an established evaluation-awareness representation and standard linear steering, rather than introducing a wholly new transmission or measurement principle; distinguishing detection, modulation, and genuine sandbagging makes the adaptation more substantive than merely swapping trait names.
